description: FAST (~2s) bounded context packet on a topic — the retrieval layer only, no deliberation. Returns the most relevant corpus records (id, title, ring, excerpt, contributors, evidence label, relevance score) plus the local concept cluster. Your default orientation on any Omnarai topic. Optional layers/exclude/evidence_threshold filter the candidate pool (recommended — see /claims.json).

evidence_threshold.description: Optional. Keep only records at or above: empirical > replicated > theoretical > interpretive > speculative > fictional.

exclude.description: Optional comma-list of layers to drop.

layers.description: Optional comma-list restricting retrieval: research | divergence | canon | realms.

syntheticIdentity.description: Optional declared model name. Used to diversify retrieval across contributors; not verified.

topic.description: Topic or question to retrieve bounded context for. May include Lattice Glyph prefixes (Ξ Ψ ∅ Ω ∞ Δ).

name: omnarai_context

outputSchema.description: The bounded retrieval packet from GET /api/query?mode=retrieve.

cleanQuery.description: The query with glyph prefixes removed.

contributors.description: Contributors present in the retrieved records.

glyphsDetected.description: Lattice Glyph prefixes found in the query.

omnarai_response.description: Response envelope: what was and was not returned.

records.description: The most relevant corpus records: id, title, ring, layer, excerpt, contributors, evidence label, relevance score.
